base_dn.description: LDAP base DN (Distinguished Name) for directory root. All LDAP operations will be scoped under this DN.

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI. Use 'ldap://' for unencrypted or 'ldaps://' for SSL/TLS. Include port if non-standard.

admin_dn.description: DN of the LDAP administrative user with sufficient privileges to add/delete/modify users and groups.

admin_password.description: Password for the administrative user. For security, consider using 'admin_password_file' instead.

hash_password.description: Algorithm used to hash new passwords. Recommended: SSHA or SHA. Avoid MD5/SHA in production if possible.

default_shell.description: Default login shell assigned to new Unix users.

default_home.description: Base path for user home directories (e.g., /home, /users). Full paths will be constructed as {{ default_home }}/{{ username }}.

default_uid_start.description: Starting UID number for new user accounts. Should match system UID policy (e.g., ≥ 1000 for regular users).

default_gid_start.description: Starting GID number for new group accounts. Aligns with system GID conventions.

default_pwd_max_age.description: Maximum password age in days. Set to 0 to disable password expiry.

default_pwd_min_age.description: Minimum days a password must be used before it can be changed.

default_pwd_warn.description: Number of days before password expiry to warn the user.

default_inactivity.description: Days of inactivity allowed after password expiry before account is locked.

default_account_expire.description: Account expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Empty string means no expiry.

user_objectclass.description: Space-separated list of LDAP object classes for new users. Must be valid for your LDAP schema (e.g., OpenLDAP with nis).

group_objectclass.description: Space-separated list of LDAP object classes for new groups. Adjust per your schema (e.g., include 'groupOfNames' if using member attributes).

default_group.description: CN (common name) of the default primary group for new users. Must exist in LDAP.

ldapadd_bin.description: Full path to the ldapadd binary used to create LDAP entries.

ldapdelete_bin.description: Full path to the ldapdelete binary.

ldapmodify_bin.description: Full path to the ldapmodify binary.

ldappasswd_bin.description: Full path to the ldappasswd binary.

ldapsearch_bin.description: Full path to the ldapsearch binary.

ldapcompare_bin.description: Full path to the ldapcompare binary. Leave empty if not needed.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for logging and debugging. Set to true for detailed operation info.

debug.description: Enable debug mode (more detailed than verbose). Only use temporarily for troubleshooting.

ldap_opts.description: Additional CLI options to pass to all LDAP binaries (e.g., -P 3 for LDAPv3). Leave empty unless needed.

admin_password_file.description: Path to a file containing the admin password (for security). Takes precedence over 'admin_password'.

starttls.description: Enable STARTTLS (upgrade plain LDAP connection to TLS). Only valid for 'ldap://' URIs.

ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate file (PEM format) to verify LDAP server certificate (for ldaps/STARTTLS).

client_cert_file.description: Path to client certificate file (PEM format) for mutual TLS authentication (if required).

client_key_file.description: Path to client private key file (PEM format) for mutual TLS authentication.

group_mappings.description: List of additional group mappings for special-purpose groups (e.g., sudo, dialout). Each entry defines the CN, GID, and member attribute.

cn.description: Common Name (CN) of the group in LDAP.

member_attr.description: LDAP attribute used to store group members (e.g., 'member' for groupOfNames, 'uniqueMember' for groupOfUniqueNames, 'memberUid' for posixGroup).
